description: A turn-based gothic puzzle game for the Game Boy Advance. On Halloween night, the Hollow Bell of Grimlight Manor tolls for the dead - and something has stolen the manor's soul relics. You are the last lantern-keeper: cross 30 rooms in six chapters, from the manor, crypt, and belfry down to the Deep Bell, the Ember Deep, and the Molten Choir, recover every relic, and lay the haunting to rest. Every step you take, the haunting takes one too. Your lantern is your shield and your life: wraiths drift toward you through the dark but cannot enter the light, and your oil burns down with every step. Push braziers and bone slabs, time the skeletons' patrols, freeze the gloomweavers in bright light, slip the Wardens' killing gaze, cross rivers of blood, lava, and acid - each with its own rule - and ring bell portals across the room. Every room's intro shows a passcode, so you can return to it directly. Written in C.
title: GRIMLIGHT: The Hollow Bell
